thread:
rachel: quick notewe've got a handful of tenants where quota rows show requests > issued tokens. not a big outage but recurring. looks like the proxy is reusing claim metadata across token rotations for those tenants.
tomo: can you share a sample log line? curious if it's project keys or short-lived SA tokens.
li: sample from staging: `proxy: tenant=acme claim_fp=0x4f2a token_id=tok_c3 ttl=20s fingerprint_expiry=120s` -> fingerprint_expiry >> ttl so same fingerprint used after token rotate.
punit: idea: introduce a compact `claim_fingerprint` (fp) and surface a "delta" column on the quota dashboard: `delta = requests - issued_tokens` per fp. That makes it obvious which fingerprints are producing surplus counts.
rachel: i like delta. telemetry changes: (A) add `claim_fingerprint` label to `api_requests_total` (B) add recording rule `auth:claim:delta:count` to compute `sum(requests)-sum(issued)` by fp, (C) emit a counter `auth_proxy_fp_reused_total` when proxy attaches an fp older than the token.
tomo: promql for the recording rule: `sum by (tenant, claim_fingerprint) (increase(api_requests_total{handler="proxy"}[5m])) - sum by (tenant, claim_fingerprint) (increase(token_issued_total[5m]))` then store as `auth:claim:delta:count`. we can alert on `auth:claim:delta:count > 0`.
li: rollout plan: behind flag `auth.proxy.claim_fp=true`. canary phases: 0.2% for 20m (smoke), then 2% for 1h, then 10% for 2h. gating: no spike in 5xx, delta per tenant < 1% of baseline, and latency P50 no regress. if `auth_proxy_fp_reused_total > 0` during canary keep canary but bump trace sampling to 25% for affected tenant.
punit: on the console UX: add a small delta column with color coding (green: <=0, amber: 0<x<=5% of issued, red: >5%). clicking the delta should open a quick modal listing top claim_fingerprints and a mini timeline (last 1h). also add a quick action link: "Request proxy cache flush" for oncall (permissioned).
rachel: question on cost: adding label to every request metric increases cardinality. keep claim_fingerprint trimmed to 8 hex chars and only enable at the proxy ingress so we avoid combinatorial explosion. also add a sampling knob: `auth.proxy.fp_sample_rate` default 1% per tenant; when delta alert fires we auto-scale that tenant to 10% sampling for 30m.
tomo: agree. i'll implement label + opt-in sampling config. i'll also add a recording rule and an alert with `for: 5m` and mute low-volume tenants (<100 tokens in window).
li: for traces we should add a short span attribute `claim_fp` so we can trace noisy tenants. enable OTEL sampling for fp-sampled requests.
punit: i'll update the quota dashboard schema: add `delta` column, heatmap row when any red cells, and an inline help tooltip linking to runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/claim-fingerprint.md
rachel: gating policy: do not generalize the flag org-wide unless we see stable delta<=0 across all canary tenants for 6h. otherwise keep it per-tenant + auto-sampling.
deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-proxy/canary -> k8s-redwood/us-east-1 (id: deploy-2026-06-15-021) :rocket:
tomo: i'll open the PR now with feature-flag, prom rule, dashboard patch, and the small sampling controller. will include a benchmark for prometheus cardinality impact.
li: i'll run the promql in staging and post a graph in ~30m. if delta persists we should consider conservative cache eviction on token rotate as fallback.
rachel: great. thanks all :thumbsup:
